description: A Spark build's parameters.spark (0.7.7 preview): the runtime enum including local, the keys each runtime takes or refuses, the release label grammar per runtime, sparkConf and source; and properties.package, a prebuilt PySpark package, with its required members, uri, digest and entry-point grammars, arguments and dead-letter table.
